name: Counted input
summary: A single-line settings field whose character counter shows only while the field is focused and is hidden at rest — the shared CountedInput pattern for option/answer text.
highlights: Character counter shows only while focused
Shared pattern for option and answer text
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-counted-input> — the settings-panel text field. Its character counter is REVEALED ONLY ON FOCUS and hidden at rest (SETTINGS-21 / SETTINGS-42): a permanently-visible counter on every field is the anti-pattern. The counter is a persistent overlay INSIDE the field (absolute, right-aligned) — never a sibling beside it, which would steal width and misalign stacked fields — and the right padding is always reserved so revealing it never shifts the text. Focus toggles an attribute on a persistent node, so the opacity transition actually fires. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; emits composed `input` / `change`. Zero drift — the same element in React and Vue.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: height 40 (default) · radius 8 · padding 0 12 · 240 wide, full width in a stacked setting row

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: settings panel: default 40 only, no small and no dense row · large 48 and touch 56 are audience-field sizes only (inside <aha-audience-field>), never in a settings panel · all radius 8

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: #E70E68 border + soft 2px ring (focus-ring-soft, 30% #E70E68) (on the persistent wrapper); hover #E70E68 border

spec.label: Counter
spec.value: 12/18 #616161, overlay inside the field, right 12; opacity 0 at rest → 1 on focus; counts the characters left (36 for 24 of 60), as the settings lab does; at size touch 12/12

spec.label: Reveal
spec.value: focus-only (:host([_focused][_counted])) — hidden at rest; space always reserved (no shift)

spec.label: Text
spec.value: Plus Jakarta 14/21, letter-spacing 0.2px (paragraph token); counter 12/18, 0.3px (subtext token); placeholder #616161

props.name: type
props.type: text | number | email | tel | url | password
props.desc: number gives a numeric field (numeric keypad on a phone); pair with maxlength="none". email, tel and url give the phone's email, dial-pad or web-address keyboard and the browser's own check; password masks the text (no reveal toggle). Any other value renders as text

props.name: inputmode
props.type: none | text | decimal | numeric | tel | search | email | url
props.desc: Passed to the inner field: picks the phone keyboard without changing the type. inputmode="decimal" (or numeric) on a text field gives a number keypad and keeps partial input such as 1e or -, which type="number" drops

props.name: autocomplete
props.desc: Passed to the inner field: the autofill hint (name, email, tel-national, organization…)

props.name: dir
props.desc: Passed to the inner field. Set dir="auto" on any field for text people type, so an Arabic or Hebrew answer reads right to left; the counter and the field keep their place

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: Accessible name, forwarded to the inner field (a placeholder is not a label); <aha-audience-field> sets it from its label

props.name: maxlength
props.desc: Character cap (settings-lab default 100); drives the focus-only counter (shows the characters left). Pass `none` to drop the cap and hide the counter

props.name: size
props.desc: Control height — small 32 · default 40 · large 48 with 16px text on a 24px line · touch 56 (16px text, 16px side padding); radius stays 8. A settings panel uses default only: small is for other surfaces, large and touch belong to the audience field inside <aha-audience-field>, and screen-lint --surface=settings rejects small and large

props.name: status
props.desc: Error recolours the border + ring and sets aria-invalid

props.name: readonly
props.desc: Selectable but not editable; secondary fill

props.name: autofocus
props.desc: Focuses the inner field once, when the element connects (a password gate or a single-field screen). Shows the same focus ring as a click and, with maxlength set, the counter

props.name: focus(options)
props.desc: Focuses the inner field, as a native input's focus() does; options.preventScroll is honoured. The host also delegates focus, so a click on the box or a tab stop lands in the field. No need to reach into shadowRoot

props.name: input
props.desc: Composed event on each keystroke; read e.detail.value

whenToUse.when: a settings option/answer/label field that needs a character cap — the counter appears only on focus
the same, but multi-line (descriptions, long answers)
a general single-line field with no counter (names, search)

opinion.note: Never show a permanent counter on every field — it reads as heavy and steals width. The counter belongs inside the field, revealed on focus. Label the field with a noun phrase; use placeholder for an example, never as the label.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab CountedInput control mapped into the DS. Box, sizes, border, focus ring and error status reuse the DS V3 field family (input) tokens; the counter is the settings-specific addition — a focus-only overlay (SETTINGS-21/42), not a standing sibling.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: height 40 (default) · radius 8 — no small or large field in a settings panel
counter hidden at rest, revealed on focus (opacity), overlay inside the field
counter space reserved — revealing it does not shift the text
